pairs.source_text: Praca zdalna z Polski. Wynagrodzenie 18 000–24 000 PLN miesięcznie na B2B. Wymagamy 3 lat doświadczenia w Python i SQL.
pairs.canonical_english: Remote work from Poland. Compensation of 18,000–24,000 PLN per month on a B2B contract. We require 3 years of experience with Python and SQL.

pairs.source_text: Rola hybrydowa w Warszawie, dwa dni w biurze. Nie wymagamy doświadczenia komercyjnego z Kubernetes.
pairs.canonical_english: Hybrid role in Warsaw, two days in the office. We do not require commercial experience with Kubernetes.

pairs.source_text: Dołączysz do AI Platform team. Będziesz budować RAG pipelines i evaluation harnesses w Python. No on-call duty is required.
pairs.canonical_english: You will join the AI Platform team. You will build RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses in Python. No on-call duty is required.

pairs.source_text: This is a fully remote Applied AI Engineer role for candidates based in Poland. Travel is not required.
pairs.canonical_english: This is a fully remote Applied AI Engineer role for candidates based in Poland. Travel is not required.
